demo.accroche: Ainihin manhajar, bayanan ƙagaggu, ba tare da yin rajista ba. Ana sake saitawa kowane dare.

j1.corps: Barka da zuwa. Gwajin tsarin {{formule}} na ci gaba. Don fara da kyau: ƙirƙiri takardarku ta farko, gayyaci abokin aiki, sannan kunna sanarwa. Cibiyar taimako da tawagarmu ta WhatsApp suna amsa duk wata tambaya.

j3.corps: Idan gwaji ya ƙare, fitar da bayanai, masu amfani da yawa, API da mataimaki SARA za su rufe. Bayananku kuwa za su ci gaba da kasancewa. Duba tsare-tsaren don riƙe dukkan ayyuka.

j1_final.objet: Rana ta ƙarshe ta gwaji — an adana bayananku
j1_final.corps: Babu gaggawa: wurin aikinku zai koma matakin Gano ta atomatik kuma bayananku za su ci gaba da kasancewa. Idan kuna son riƙe fitar da bayanai, masu amfani da yawa da mataimaki SARA, kunna tsari a duk lokacin da kuke so.

j0.corps: Wurin aikinku yanzu yana matakin Gano: {{plafond}} suna nan don gyarawa, sauran karatu kawai ne. Ba a share komai ba. Kunna tsari a kowane lokaci don dawo da rubutu a kan dukkan bayananku.

j7.corps: Muna nan don ɗan gajeren tattaunawa, ba tare da wani alkawari ba. Wurin aikinku na Gano ya ci gaba da buɗewa: kuna iya amfani da shi muddin kuke so.

j60.corps: Za a share bayananku a {{date}}. Sake kunna biyan kuɗinku ko ku nemi fitar da bayanai ta support@ibigsoft.com.
